id.instruksi: Program robot kebun punya bagian yang berulang. Pilih prosedur yang paling tepat: tepat satu satuan yang berulang, atau prosedur berparameter bila hanya nilainya yang berbeda.
id.q1: Robot kebun: gali, tanam, siram, maju 2, gali, tanam, siram, maju 2, gali, tanam, siram, maju 2. Bagian mana yang paling cocok dijadikan prosedur?
id.c4: panen_dua(): petik, petik, taruh di keranjang
id.q2: Robot panen: petik, petik, taruh di keranjang, petik, petik, taruh di keranjang, petik, petik, taruh di keranjang, pulang. Prosedur mana yang paling tepat?
id.q3: Siram pot berbaris: maju 1, siram, siram, maju 1, siram, siram, maju 1, siram, siram, maju 1, siram, siram. Prosedur apa yang paling berguna?
id.c10: baris(n): maju n, tanam n biji
id.q4: Dua bagian ini sama kecuali angkanya: (maju 2, tanam 2 biji) dan (maju 5, tanam 5 biji). Prosedur yang paling berguna adalah…
id.c13: siram(tanaman, liter): ambil liter air, siram tanaman
id.q5: Program: ambil 1 liter air, siram mawar; ambil 3 liter air, siram pisang; ambil 2 liter air, siram cabai. Prosedur yang paling baik adalah…
id.c16: kalau perlu diubah, cukup ubah di satu tempat
id.q6: Prosedur tanam_bibit() dipakai di 5 petak kebun. Apa untungnya menulisnya sebagai prosedur?
id.q7: Program pagi: buka gerbang, beri makan ayam, kumpulkan telur, beri makan ayam, sapu kandang, beri makan ayam. Bagian mana yang cocok jadi prosedur?
id.q8: Prosedur cangkul() = ayun, tarik. Petak kebun butuh 8 kali cangkul. Program terpendek yang tetap mencangkul 8 kali adalah…
id.q9: Robot lebah: terbang 3, isap madu, terbang 3, isap madu, terbang 3, isap madu, kembali ke sarang. Prosedur mana yang paling pas?
id.q10: Pagar kebun kecil: ulangi 4: maju 3, kanan. Pagar kebun besar: ulangi 4: maju 6, kanan. Prosedur yang paling berguna adalah…
id.q11: Bagian 'kalau hujan: tutup atap rumah kaca, matikan pompa' ditulis di 3 tempat dalam program. Sebaiknya…
id.c35: tanam jagung, tanam kacang, tanam jagung
id.q12: Pola tanam: jagung, kacang, jagung, kacang, jagung, kacang. Prosedur mana yang paling tepat?

en.instruksi: The garden robot's program has parts that repeat. Choose the best procedure: exactly one repeating unit, or a procedure with a parameter when only the values change.
en.q1: Garden robot: dig, plant, water, forward 2, dig, plant, water, forward 2, dig, plant, water, forward 2. Which part fits best as a procedure?
en.c4: pick_two(): pick, pick, put in basket
en.q2: Harvest robot: pick, pick, put in basket, pick, pick, put in basket, pick, pick, put in basket, go home. Which procedure fits best?
en.q3: Watering a row of pots: forward 1, water, water, forward 1, water, water, forward 1, water, water, forward 1, water, water. Which procedure is most useful?
en.c10: row(n): forward n, plant n seeds
en.q4: These two parts are the same except for the number: (forward 2, plant 2 seeds) and (forward 5, plant 5 seeds). The most useful procedure is…
en.c13: water(plant, litres): fetch litres of water, water the plant
en.q5: Program: fetch 1 litre of water, water the rose; fetch 3 litres, water the banana; fetch 2 litres, water the chilli. The best procedure is…
en.c16: if it needs changing, you change it in one place
en.q6: The procedure plant_seedling() is used in 5 garden plots. What is the benefit of writing it as a procedure?
en.q7: Morning program: open the gate, feed the hens, collect eggs, feed the hens, sweep the coop, feed the hens. Which part fits as a procedure?
en.q8: The procedure hoe() = swing, pull. The plot needs 8 hoe strokes. The shortest program that still hoes 8 times is…
en.q9: Bee robot: fly 3, sip nectar, fly 3, sip nectar, fly 3, sip nectar, back to the hive. Which procedure fits best?
en.q10: Small garden fence: repeat 4: forward 3, right. Big garden fence: repeat 4: forward 6, right. The most useful procedure is…
en.q11: The part 'if it rains: close the greenhouse roof, switch off the pump' is written in 3 places in the program. It is best to…
en.c35: plant corn, plant beans, plant corn
en.q12: Planting pattern: corn, beans, corn, beans, corn, beans. Which procedure fits best?
